All five pages created. Each is a self-contained HTML file replicating the Hacker News design:

- `home.html` — main story listing with mixed content (stories, Ask HN, job posts, Show HN)
- `ask.html` — Ask HN list with the rules preamble and `ask` tab bolded
- `show.html` — Show HN list with the newest/all-time-top preamble and `show` tab bolded
- `jobs.html` — Jobs list (no points/byline, just timestamp + hide) with `jobs` tab bolded
- `new.html` — Newest submissions with a `flag` link between byline and `hide`, and the extra `threads` nav link

Shared styling: orange `#ff6600` header bar with white-bordered "Y" logo, off-white `#f6f6ef` body, Verdana 10pt, gray subtext at 7pt, upvote triangle arrows, and the bordered footer with site links + search box.
